search.snippet: The pointed Bruise blue snelm is a members-only helmet. There are no requirements to wear it. It is made from a Blamish blue shell (pointed) using a Chisel and the Crafting skill. Only the pointed form is allowed for the clue; the round snelm does not work. The pointed bruise blue snelm is a type of helmet created by using a chisel on a pointed blamish blue shell. Doing so requires level 15 in Crafting, and grants 32.5 experience. A pointed blamish blue shell is an item dropped by Bruise Blamish Snails with pointed shells in the Mort Myre Swamp. Players with level 15 in Crafting can use a chisel on it to turn it into a pointed bruise blue snelm, which gives 32.5 experience. Players can create a snelm through the Crafting skill at level 15, by using a chisel on the shell of any snail found in Mort Myre swamp or near the Haunted Woods. There are a variety of colours for both round and pointed snelms, and they give considerable protection against the snails of Morytania. [1] ^ Jagex.
